description: This file contains the implementation of a simple in-memory cache class 'SimpleCache1' that implements the 'CacheInterface'. It provides basic caching functionalities such as get, set, delete, and bulk operations within PHPSpreadsheet's memory collection context.

classes.name: SimpleCache1
classes.description: A basic in-memory cache class implementing PSR-16 CacheInterface for use within PHPSpreadsheet to cache cell data.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the cache by resetting the internal cache array.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: deleteMultiple
methods.description: Deletes multiple cache entries given an iterable of keys.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key, returns default if key does not exist.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cached values for given iterable of keys.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the cache.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache under the specified key, with optional TTL.

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Stores multiple key-value pairs in cache.
